mechanism_narrative: The sharp jump in GROCERY_PHARM indicates precautionary stocking and trip consolidation, which reduces discretionary retail visits and pulls RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose from 11.0 at t-1w to 18.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than its prior 28-day mean despite continued elevated GROCERY_PHARM, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden collapse in TRANSIT below zero marks a mobility restriction or avoidance regime; within one week it suppresses spontaneous retail trips and drives RETAIL_REC lower.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses from positive to negative week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from 11.4 at t-1w to -2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next week after TRANSIT turns negative, the threshold mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall together, commuting-linked retail stops disappear faster than they are replaced by other trips, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from 9.9 to -1.7 while TRANSIT dropped from 11.4 to -2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain weak but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days, the interaction claim is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates people staying home more, which reduces neighborhood retail visits and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average for the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above its prior 3-week mean
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL moved from -1.7 at t-1w to 2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If higher RESIDENTIAL is followed by no decline in RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PARKS use diverts outings toward outdoor recreation and away from shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next two weeks when PARKS stays elevated.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS increased from 0.6 at t-1w to 8.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If elevated PARKS does not coincide with a lower RETAIL_REC mean over the next 14 days, this substitution mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL indicates more home-and-neighborhood activity, which substitutes for mall and store visits and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose to 8.1 while RESIDENTIAL rose to 2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise but RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days, the interaction is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES fall below zero, employers have shifted to remote work or closures, and retail demand tied to lunchtime and after-work shopping drops within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from 9.9 at t-1w to -1.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not fall within one week after WORKPLACES turns negative, the claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains high while TRANSIT stays depressed, households are concentrating trips into essentials and avoiding discretionary centers, which lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below its prior 2-week mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 10
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM reached 18.4 and TRANSIT fell to -2.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If high GROCERY_PHARM and weak TRANSIT coexist but RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days, the mechanism fails.
